verdict.rationale: PlayCanvas documents an official Editor MCP Server that connects AI assistants to a live Editor session, letting them modify project data and verify results via the viewport, and this is corroborated by a direct probe confirming the docs page exists and by another doc referencing 'from an agent with the MCP server.'
